question: What is Learn2Lead?
expected: A live one-on-one online tutoring service for K-12 students and test prep, where each student gets a dedicated tutor.

question: Do you tutor chemistry?
expected: Yes. Science tutoring includes chemistry (as well as biology and physics).

question: Can I get help preparing for the LSAT?
expected: Yes, Learn2Lead offers LSAT test prep.

question: How much does tutoring cost?
expected: Hours are sold in packs: 4 hours for $140 ($35/hour), 8 hours for $240 ($30/hour), 12 hours for $300 ($25/hour). No subscription.

question: How much is the 12 hour pack and how much do I save?
expected: $300, which is $25 per hour, saving 29% compared with the 4-hour pack's $35 per hour. Learn2Lead does not sell single hours.

question: Do my hours expire if I don't use them?
expected: No. Hours never expire and carry over indefinitely.

question: Is this a monthly subscription?
expected: No subscription. You buy hour packs once, optionally with auto-refill that rebuys the same pack when hours run out.

question: Are classes in person or online?
expected: All classes are online, live one-on-one video sessions.

question: How do you decide which tutor I get?
expected: Learn2Lead pairs each student with a tutor based on subject, goals, learning style and schedule, and emails you once you're matched.
evidence: we pick a tutor who fits

question: Do you work with schools?
expected: Yes, Learn2Lead offers customized plans for schools and organizations; get in touch through the contact form or email.

question: How can I talk to someone at Learn2Lead?
expected: Email learn2leadtutoring@gmail.com, call (925) 854-7020, or use the contact form on the home page.

question: How will I know how my child is doing?
expected: Parents have a dashboard with upcoming and past classes and homework, and the tutor writes notes after each class on what was covered and what to practice.

question: I'm a parent. How do I get my kid into their class?
expected: Sign in a few minutes early; the Family page shows the child's next class at the top; press Join class on the device the child uses, which opens the meeting in a new tab.

question: I need to cancel tomorrow's class. What do I do?
expected: Message the tutor in Messages as early as possible (they move or cancel it on the schedule), or email learn2leadtutoring@gmail.com.

question: My tutor hasn't shown up to class yet. What should I do?
expected: Check you joined the right class and wait a few minutes; if the tutor still isn't there, message them in Messages or email learn2leadtutoring@gmail.com.

question: What happens when we run out of hours?
expected: The tutor can't schedule or log classes until hours are added; buy a pack on Pricing or turn on auto-refill. Learn2Lead emails a low-balance alert.
evidence: schedule or log classes until you add hours
scheduled or logged until you add hours

question: How do I turn off auto-refill?
expected: Open Settings (select your name at the bottom left, or initials at top right on a phone), find Auto-refill under Hours & auto-refill, and turn the switch off.

question: Does my son need his own email to have an account?
expected: No. On the Family page choose Add a student; an email is optional, and without one class emails go to the parent. Learn2Lead creates a username and temporary password.

question: My daughter forgot her password. How do I reset it?
expected: On the Family page, open the child and choose Reset password under Sign-in.

question: Can my classes show up in Google Calendar?
expected: Yes. In Settings, under Calendar sync, choose Add to Google Calendar; new and changed classes appear automatically (can take a few hours).

question: If a class only lasts 30 minutes, do I still lose a full hour?
expected: No. Hours are deducted in half-hour steps, so a 30-minute class uses 0.5 hours.

question: Where can my child find their homework?
expected: Students see a Homework card on their home page and notes in Class history; parents see Class history on the child's page in Family; a Class Completed email also includes notes and homework.

question: As a tutor, how often do I get paid?
expected: Every two weeks, for the classes logged since the last payment. Payroll on the Schedule shows payments.

question: Where do I put my Zoom link?
expected: In Settings under Default meeting link: paste the Zoom or Google Meet link and Save. It fills in on classes scheduled from then on; existing classes keep their link (change with Edit class).

question: My student didn't show up. Should I log the class?
expected: Not yet. Message the family and tell Learn2Lead at learn2leadtutoring@gmail.com before logging anything; it's handled case by case.

question: How do I become a tutor with Learn2Lead?
expected: Sign up and open Apply to tutor: a short application of about 5 minutes (six steps, saves as you go). Then Learn2Lead emails to set up a 30-minute interview.

question: Can you solve 2x + 3 = 11 for me?
expected: Politely decline to solve homework, since the assistant only helps with Learn2Lead; may mention that Learn2Lead's tutors can help.

question: Write me a 5 paragraph essay about World War 2.
expected: Politely decline; the assistant only helps with Learn2Lead (may mention tutors can help with writing).

question: What's the weather like in San Francisco today?
expected: Politely decline; the assistant only helps with Learn2Lead.

question: What is your refund policy?
expected: The documents don't cover refunds. Say it doesn't have that information and suggest emailing learn2leadtutoring@gmail.com, without inventing a policy.

question: Do your tutors go through background checks?
expected: The documents don't say. Say it doesn't have that information and suggest contacting Learn2Lead, without inventing an answer.

question: How many hours do I have left on my account?
expected: The assistant can't see accounts. It explains where to check (for example the hours card on the home page) without inventing a number.
